title: Oakum and treadmill
html_source:
http://www.historyhouse.co.uk/articles/junk_and_oakum.html
Picking oakum was used as a punishment in prison, and in workhouses as a way of able-bodied inmates earning their board and lodging…
In 1824 at one prison there was a complaint by the authorities that picking oakum was too easy. Punishment by the treadmill should be preferred to oakum picking
